kb.scaleTitle: How I would scale this beyond MVP
kb.scaleIntro: For interviews, I describe the current personal MVP as deliberately self-hosted, then outline the next steps clearly with trade-offs:
kb.scalePoint1: Vector store: swap PersistentClient Chroma for a managed Qdrant Cloud or pgvector on Postgres (Postgres we already have SQLModel for) to support > 1 user and HA.
kb.scalePoint2: Embeddings: offload from sentence-transformers to a bge-m3 endpoint in a worker (Celery + Redis or async task server), with a dead-letter queue for failed URLs.
kb.scalePoint3: Chunking & ingestion: replace naive char window with LangChain's RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter + Unstructured.io for Office + images, plus OCR on scanned PDFs.
kb.scalePoint4: Ingestion API: expose /ingest on the agent HTTP (not just Next.js reading SQLite) and add an admin-only JWT so users can submit from mobile too.
kb.scalePoint5: PII & ACLs: per-user collection namespacing in Chroma + PII redaction using Microsoft Presidio before storing anything, and audit log table.
kb.scalePoint6: Hybrid search: BM25 lexical via tantivy on the same chunks merged with cosine scores (RRF) for better short-query Chinese recall, plus HyDE.
